hookups.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/kissimmee/ ('Full Hook-Up 50/30 AMP Pull-Thru RV sites or a Back-In RV site with a KOA Patio', '50 Max Amp') + https://koa.com/campgrounds/kissimmee/site-type/rv-camping-sites/ (site types 'PULL THRU, 50/30/20 AMPS, FULL HOOKUPS ...'), read 2026-10-21 in a browser

values.note: Full-hookup 50/30-amp pull-thrus (the KOA Patio big-rig ones 'extra long, 100ft plus') and back-in KOA Patio sites; KOA lists a 134-ft max length, left out of max_rig_ft as a site length rather than a rig limit. No fire rings at the back-in sites.

sites.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/kissimmee/site-type/rv-camping-sites/ ('Stay on one of our extra long, 100ft plus long, KOA Patio Pull Thru sites!') + https://koa.com/campgrounds/kissimmee/amenities/ ("134' Max Length") + https://koa.com/campgrounds/kissimmee/general-information/ ('there are no fire rings/pits provided in our Back-In sites'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 24-hour laundry; free Wi-Fi throughout the park (no streaming) and free cable TV at RV sites; heated pool and hot tub open year-round; EV charging ($), dog wash, propane.

facilities.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/kissimmee/amenities/ ('24 Hour Laundry', 'Wi-Fi', 'Cable TV', 'Electric Vehicle (EV) Charging') + https://koa.com/campgrounds/kissimmee/general-information/ ('Free Wifi is available throughout the park'; 'Firewood is sold in our General Store') + home page ('all with free cable and Wi-Fi'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Book on koa.com or 407-396-2400. Late arrivals use night registration at the store: pick an available site, set up, register next morning. RV sites: cancel by 4 p.m. seven days ahead for a refund less $20 (two weeks for holidays and special events). 6 or 8 people per site, day visitors included. Monthly stays offered in summer.

booking.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/kissimmee/general-information/ (Late Check-In & Night Registration: 'Select from available sites, park and setup, and then come into the store the next morning to get registered'; Cancellation Policy; Number of Guests per Reservation) + https://koa.com/campgrounds/kissimmee/ ('We also offer monthly stays during the summer months'), read 2026-10-21

note: KOA Holiday at 2644 Happy Camper Place, Kissimmee, under 25 minutes from Walt Disney World, SeaWorld, Universal and LEGOLAND. --Claude
